status: Prospective concrete candidate for lead value/source review; numerical stage NOT authorized
source_claim: PMC3879193 Conclusions: Series like ours may serve as external controls for future clinical studies on new agents in such a rare histology.
proposed_question: Can this specific published anthracycline historical-control series supply an interpretable six-month systemic-treatment benchmark when complete surgery is a separate intercurrent event rather than assumed independent censoring?
proposed_estimand: Separate cumulative incidence by six months of recorded radiographic progression/death and complete-surgery conversion from an authenticated common chemotherapy-start origin; only verified ordinary last-contact censoring. Surgery is neither progression nor an invented treatment-failure composite. If relevant, source-supported partial-identification bounds for the hypothetical no-surgery progression risk, with assumptions explicit.
source_scope: Every one of the 11 original molecularly supported EMC rows; no favorable subset and no pooling with unlinked modern trial cohorts.
required_preconditions: Explicit common start origin and units
Each source duration linked to event, ordinary censor or surgery with unambiguous coding
Independent challenge finds useful consequence beyond known censoring and historical endpoint audit
Lead authorization and full prospective numerical-method freeze before individual values
strongest_alternative: Complete surgery may be a clinically beneficial part of the treatment strategy; observed surgery-incidence is not evidence that anthracycline fails or succeeds. Censoring changes the estimand and may be informative, but its direction or magnitude cannot be inferred merely from the policy. Selection, assessment and line differences may dominate any numerical change.
disproof_or_value_defeat: Common origin or event/censor map cannot be authenticated
Confidence/bounds are too broad or consequence does not change benchmark interpretation
No important specific claim beyond a generic caution about nonrandom intercurrent events
Question is already answered by original reported resections and postoperative course or existing endpoint package
Necessary all-public comparative evidence remains inaccessible or unlinked
published_aggregate_context: Owner has read the paper Methods/Discussion/Conclusions and prior R7 results, including published aggregate surgery/recurrence context. No full outcome-blinding claim; no individual PFS values newly accessed.
initial_value_judgment: Standalone paper unlikely: small selected series, missing postoperative per-patient timelines and existing known surgery censoring. It may justify a bounded decisive calculation only if the lead identifies a concrete benchmark consequence. Missingness or protocol critique alone is not a finding.
